china: China hosts the majority of global silica aerogel blanket capacity, built on water-glass chemistry and continuous supercritical drying lines. This concentration is why factory-direct China quotes anchor the low end of global aerogel pricing. The listings below include producers, converters, and trading channels; for volume sourcing, verification of production lots and third-party spec testing remains the decisive step.
usa: The United States combines brand-system manufacturing with the largest certified distribution network in the industry. Demand concentrates in oil and gas, LNG, and industrial insulation, with EV battery thermal barriers the fastest-growing segment. Buyers here typically work to project specifications, so certified systems and engineering support weigh more than unit price.
germany: Germany anchors the European market for engineering-led aerogel sourcing. The supplier structure leans toward distributors, converters, and solution providers serving industrial processing, petrochemical, and building applications. Buyers expect full technical documentation and EN-compliant fire classification data before quotation rounds begin.
united-kingdom: The UK market splits between offshore oil and gas insulation and building retrofit projects where thin-profile performance matters. Supply runs largely through distributor and converter channels. Fire-safety classification and reaction-to-fire test data for the specific assembly are the usual procurement gate.
france: French aerogel demand is driven by industrial insulation, nuclear and aerospace research programs, and energy-efficiency retrofits. The local supplier base is small, so most projects are served through Belgian and German distribution networks. Buyers comparing offers across borders should normalize quotes to delivered cost per square meter.
netherlands: The Netherlands functions as a European trade hub for advanced materials, with distributors and re-exporters concentrated around the Rotterdam chemical cluster. Listings here cover both local supply and channel partners serving projects across the EU. Lead time and stock position often decide between otherwise comparable Dutch suppliers.
belgium: Belgium's aerogel activity is tied to the Antwerp port chemical cluster and its industrial insulation maintenance cycles. The country also serves as a practical sourcing base for buyers in France and Germany, with several distributors covering cross-border projects. Project-scale procurement and consistent lot documentation are the recurring requirements.
canada: Canadian demand centers on oil sands, natural gas processing, and cryogenic facility insulation, with harsh-climate performance a recurring specification. Supply is served through both domestic distributors and US brand channels under regional trade agreements. Buyers commonly evaluate delivered cost and winter-site handling data together.
japan: Japan's aerogel market is defined by precision applications: battery and electronics thermal management, high-performance building panels, and specialty industrial uses. Suppliers operate through domestic channels with strong technical support and tight specification control. Small-order availability and lot traceability are well supported here.
